in_hebrew.name: Ulrick
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ulrick הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German 'Uuolrich' meaning 'Wealth ruler'. The name Ulrick has been popular among Germanic cultures throughout history, and has been adopted by Christians as a spiritual name.
